flavor: A single, blinding pillar of pure radiance descends from the ceiling, striking a massive, multifaceted crystal at the center of the chamber. The light shatters into a thousand dancing rainbows that slice through the heavy, incense-filled air.
name: The Prism of Refracted Souls
reason: The concentrated light creates a high-visibility environment that empowers celestial guardians while making it difficult for creatures to find cover.
